evidence: At §7.3.2 the text states: "At 262,144 cached tokens — the configuration's stated maximum context length (max_position_embeddings) — this component occupies 16 GiB (17,179,869,184 B ≈ 17.18 GB on the chapter's decimal GB basis, §7.1)." Recomputed from the book's own stated inputs (2 × 16 layers × 4 KV-heads × 256 head_dim × 2 B = 65,536 B/token; 262,144 × 65,536 = 17,179,869,184 B = 16 GiB exactly), the byte count is correct. However, the same subsection then states for half the context: "At 131,072 tokens — half that maximum, a chosen comparison point [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] — the same component is 8 GiB (8,589,934,592 B ≈ 8.59 GB decimal). Doubling history therefore adds 8 GiB (≈8.59 GB decimal) to this component under the stated assumptions". The phrase "Doubling history therefore adds 8 GiB" is ambiguous on its face — doubling the token count adds 8 GiB of KV to the component, but the reader has just been told the component *is* 8 GiB at half length and 16 GiB at full length, so "adds 8 GiB to this component" reads as 8 + 16 = 24 GiB rather than 16 GiB total. The correct reading (8 GiB additional, total 16 GiB) is inferable only from the earlier sentence.
issue: Ambiguous incremental-vs-total wording in the Qwen3.8-27B history-state arithmetic: "Doubling history therefore adds 8 GiB ... to this component" is stated without naming the resulting total, and the clause "to this component" invites the reading 8 GiB + 16 GiB = 24 GiB rather than a total of 16 GiB.
fix_instruction: Rewrite as: "Doubling the cached-token count from 131,072 to 262,144 therefore adds 8 GiB (≈8.59 GB decimal) to this component, taking it from 8 GiB to a total of 16 GiB (≈17.18 GB decimal) under the stated assumptions." Apply the same explicit-total phrasing to any other add-vs-total statements in §7.3.2 and in the Fig 7.2 caption.
